result.Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2023-1389 unauthenticated command injection vulnerability in TP-Link Archer AX21 web management interface; downloads ELF files for different Linux architectures; erases traces; connects to C2 servers; launches DDoS attacks including UDP Flood, XMAS, VSE, TCP Flood, HEX attacks; brute force attacks (Mirai variants); prevents reboots and kills processes (Condi)
Impacted Systems: TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) Version 1.1.4 Build 20230219 or prior
result.Attack Vector: Unauthenticated command injection via 'locale' API 'country' parameter in TP-Link Archer AX21 web management interface

Indicators of Compromise.Files: Multiple ELF file hashes listed in source content
